title: WDP Modpack
description: Create-powered survival, built for WDP Modpack Server.
body:
# WDP Modpack ### Create. Evolved. `mod.wdpserver.com` — Version: 1.21.1 [🌐 Website](https://wdpserver.com)  ·  [💬 Discord](https://discord.gg/A2vfymZwBE)   --- *Create-powered. Performance-first. Made for the server.*
---
## What's in this pack?
This is the official client modpack for WDP Server. Install it, launch it, connect — that's it. Everything you need to play is already here, tuned specifically for the server, with nothing unnecessary bolted on. Create is the core. With over **15 dedicated addons**, the machine-building experience goes far beyond vanilla Create — railways, enchanting machines, gliders, hyper tubes, confectionery, liquid fuel, vibrant vaults, and more. Every addon integrates naturally. The more you build, the more it clicks. Beyond Create, **Biomes O' Plenty** opens up the world, **Farmer's Delight** deepens survival, and **Distant Horizons** stretches your view distance to the literal horizon. Sodium, Iris, Lithium, and FerriteCore keep all of it running smooth. ---
## What You're Getting
- **Create & 15+ Addons** The full Create suite — Encased, Railways Navigator, Hypertube, Enchantment Industry, Confectionery, Dragons Plus, Vibrant Vaults, Liquid Fuel, Oxidized, Stuff & Additions, Rustic Structures, Power Loader, and more. A complete mechanical world. - **Performance Stack** Sodium, Iris, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, FerriteCore, ModernFix, EntityCulling, Distant Horizons. High frame rates, long render distances, shaders ready out of the box. - **World Generation** Biomes O' Plenty + TerraBlender — a dramatically expanded world with dozens of new biomes to explore. - **Building & Decoration** Chipped, CopyCats+, MCW Bridges / Doors / Fences / Trapdoors, Design n' Decor, Effortless Building, Immersive Paintings. Your builds will look different. - **Maps & Wayfinding** Xaero's Minimap + World Map and Waystones. Always know where you are, always get back fast. - **Storage Solutions** Storage Drawers, Sophisticated Backpacks (with Create integration). Your items, actually organized. - **Voice Chat** Simple Voice Chat is built in — no setup required. Just talk to nearby players. - **Quality of Life** JEI, Jade, AppleSkin, Mouse Tweaks, Carry On, Polymorph, Corpse, Comforts, Villager Names, Fast Leaf Decay, Torchmaster, and more. The small stuff that adds up. ---
